Every template below is a Quarto format extension: install it, set `format:`
in your document, and write your CV as described in
[Writing a CV](using-templates.qmd). This list is generated automatically
from the [quarto-vitae GitHub org](https://github.com/orgs/quarto-vitae/repositories)
and a small list of community templates — see
[Creating CV templates](creating-templates.qmd) if you'd like to add your own.
